rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst and appropriately describes dense ICM and cohesive TE, but includes speculative image-specific details (e.g., cavity percentage, ICM position, wall irregularities) and some uncertainty around strict Gardner stage labeling.
Thoroughly integrates age, BMI, prior biochemical pregnancies, oocyte yield, sperm parameters, endometrial thickness, diagnosis, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is mostly logical and well structured, linking morphology and patient factors to prognosis; minor inconsistency comes from shifting probability ranges and some speculative comments.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and aligned with IVF practice, including caution about add-ons and discussion of uterine evaluation and PGT-A; slight overreach/speculation on adenomyosis and some broad probability framing prevent a perfect score.
Provides clear practical next steps for current transfer management, follow-up, lifestyle modification, and structured future-cycle evaluation with specific investigations and planning options.
